_comment: Store listing copy for all three stores, per locale.

Limits honoured here: name <= 75 chars (Chrome, also drives Edge); summary <= 132 (Chrome summary + Edge short description, both read from the manifest, so these strings must match public/_locales/<locale>/messages.json exactly); description 250-10000 chars (Edge enforces the 250 minimum, which Chrome and AMO also accept).
Feature claims are identical in every language on purpose: Chrome auto-flags cross-locale metadata inconsistency, and that is the one realistic rejection risk when adding languages.
searchTerms is Edge-only: max 7 terms, 21 words total, 30 chars per term.
This file is also the source for the AMO API, which accepts localized name/summary/description objects directly.
